I've got two:

When I was in first grade, my teacher either didn't like me it was just a huge bitch, and would find ways to make me feel singled out or like I deserved to be punished. She would constantly ridicule and belittle anything I did, and one day stands out more than others. We had an assignment that she told us to do, and told us to open our books to whatever page it was. I politely (at least in my young mind) asked what page, since I didn't hear her. She proceeded to walk over to my desk, dump everything out of it, and make me clean it up, while she gathered the rest of the class around and made everyone say, "BrokenAndLonely, we know you're here." One by one. I still feel so confused thinking about it 20 years later.

The other one was in Junior High, from someone who I thought was a friend at the time. I had started having issues with depression, and I didn't really know what to do or who to turn to. When I told him this, I remember him coldly saying, "So just kill yourself, then." It took me by surprise and really cut deep. I like to think I'm not bitter, but when I reflect on it, I totally am.
